description: This file defines the MessageFactory class responsible for creating and managing message objects within the Orleans runtime messaging system. It includes methods for creating request, response, rejection, and diagnostic messages, utilizing various internal and external components such as logging, serialization, and code generation.

classes.name: MessageFactory
classes.description: A class responsible for creating different types of messages used in Orleans communication, including request, response, rejection, and status messages.

methods.name: CreateMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message with specified body and options, setting message properties based on invocation options.

methods.name: GetNextCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates a unique correlation ID for messages, combining a seed with an incremented counter.

methods.name: CreateResponseMessage
methods.description: Creates a response message based on a request message, copying relevant properties.

methods.name: CreateRejectionResponse
methods.description: Creates a rejection response message indicating failure or rejection, including optional exception details.

methods.name: CreateDiagnosticResponseMessage
methods.description: Creates a status response message with diagnostic information, indicating execution and waiting states.
